capabilities: Plot notes with coordinate properties as map markers
Load GeoJSON, CSV and HTTP JSON API data as map layers
Search, filter by date, and cluster dense markers
Create place notes from a form with configurable coordinate systems
Export the filtered view as GeoJSON or a Markdown table
disambiguation: Not a life-planning or journaling tool; despite the name it is a map view for plotting geolocated vault data.
extras: Not yet listed in the community directory, so manual installation is required. Warns that API tokens are stored in plain text in plugin data.json and that it enumerates vault file paths to find GeoJSON/CSV files. v0.9 supports points only (no GPX tracks or polygons) and basic mobile support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize geolocated notes and data files on a map, especially with basemaps that work reliably in mainland China.
summary: General-purpose map view that plots notes, GeoJSON, CSV and HTTP JSON API data as layers, with clustering, filters, a photo wall and a timeline.
